tools.name: analyze_repository
tools.description: Start here for an unfamiliar repository or a general test-architecture review. Detect and audit all project roots once, then return the complete deterministic summary, blockers, findings, ranking, plan, execution hints, verification commands, and stats. Prefer this over audit_repo unless one project root and adapter were explicitly selected.

changedPaths.description: Optional repository-relative source paths to limit target selection inside detected projects.

excludeProjectRoots.description: Optional exact project roots or subtree patterns such as examples/** to exclude before analysis.

goos.description: Explicit GOOS for bounded Go build-constraint evaluation.

goarch.description: Explicit GOARCH for bounded Go build-constraint evaluation.

tags.description: Optional custom Go build tags passed to the target-aware verification command.

tools.title: Analyze Repository

tools.name: list_adapters
tools.description: List registered language adapters available to audit repositories.
tools.title: List Adapters

tools.name: list_project_detection_rules
tools.description: List deterministic project marker rules and ignored directories used during project detection.
tools.title: List Project Detection Rules

tools.name: detect_projects
tools.description: Discover project roots, support status, and matching adapters without auditing source targets. Use this when project boundaries are needed before a specialized workflow; use analyze_repository for a complete review. Reads local repository markers and returns project-detection/v1 without executing tests or writing files.

repoRoot.description: Readable repository directory whose project markers should be inspected.

excludeProjectRoots.description: Optional exact project roots or subtree patterns such as examples/** to exclude before returning detected projects.

tools.title: Detect Projects

tools.name: audit_projects
tools.description: Return raw per-project audit artifacts for all detected supported roots and report unsupported roots. Use when a downstream specialist tool needs project-audits/v1; for a complete first-pass review, prefer analyze_repository.

changedPaths.description: Optional repository-relative source paths to limit target selection inside detected projects.

excludeProjectRoots.description: Optional exact project roots or subtree patterns such as examples/** to exclude before auditing detected projects.

goos.description: Explicit GOOS for bounded Go build-constraint evaluation.

goarch.description: Explicit GOARCH for bounded Go build-constraint evaluation.

tags.description: Optional custom Go build tags passed to the target-aware verification command.

tools.title: Audit Projects

tools.name: summarize_project_audits
tools.description: Summarize an existing project-audits/v1 artifact. Use only when a compact coverage view is needed separately; analyze_repository already includes this result.
tools.title: Summarize Project Audits

tools.name: rank_project_candidates
tools.description: Rank candidates from an existing project-audits/v1 artifact while preserving project identity. analyze_repository already includes this result.
tools.title: Rank Project Test Candidates

tools.name: generate_project_test_plan
tools.description: Generate a project-aware plan from an existing project-audits/v1 artifact. analyze_repository already includes this result.
tools.title: Generate Project Test Plan

tools.name: collect_project_findings
tools.description: Collect concise top findings from an existing project-audits/v1 artifact. analyze_repository already includes this result.
tools.title: Collect Project Findings

tools.name: analyze_project_test_placement
tools.description: Derive advisory test-placement findings across an existing project-audits/v1 artifact while preserving project identity. Use this for multiple audited projects; use analyze_test_placement for one audit/v1 artifact. Does not rescan the repository, execute tests, or create, move, or modify files.

projectAudits.description: The project-audits/v1 object returned by audit_projects; pass the artifact itself, not a file path.

tools.title: Analyze Project Test Placement

tools.name: collect_project_stats
tools.description: Aggregate coverage, counts, risk and signal distributions, frameworks, and adapter usage from an existing project-audits/v1 artifact. Use this for separate reporting or comparisons; analyze_repository already includes the same stats. Returns project-stats/v1 without rescanning the repository, executing tests, or writing files.

projectAudits.description: The project-audits/v1 object returned by audit_projects; pass the artifact itself, not a file path.

tools.title: Collect Project Stats

tools.name: audit_repo
tools.description: Audit one explicitly selected project root and return audit/v1. Use only when the caller selected a single adapter or project boundary; adapterId defaults to javascript. For an unfamiliar or complete repository review, use analyze_repository.

adapterId.description: Optional adapter id. Defaults to javascript.

changedPaths.description: Optional repository-relative source paths to limit target selection.

goos.description: Explicit GOOS for bounded Go build-constraint evaluation.

goarch.description: Explicit GOARCH for bounded Go build-constraint evaluation.

tags.description: Optional custom Go build tags passed to the target-aware verification command.

tools.title: Audit Repository

tools.name: get_audit_graph
tools.description: Validate and return an existing audit/v1 artifact unchanged; this does not scan a repository. Use audit_repo or analyze_repository for repository discovery.
tools.title: Get Audit Graph

tools.name: generate_test_plan
tools.description: Create a deterministic plan/v1 from an existing single-project audit/v1 artifact. Use this after audit_repo, optionally selecting one exact plan item; use generate_project_test_plan for multiple audited projects. Does not rescan the repository, execute tests, or generate or write test code.

audit.description: The audit/v1 object returned by audit_repo or contained in projectAudits.audits[].audit; pass the artifact itself, not a file path.

itemId.description: Optional exact plan item id to return; omit it to return the complete deterministic plan.

tools.title: Generate Test Plan

tools.name: get_plan_execution_hints
tools.description: Derive provider-neutral execution, context, parallel-safety, and repository-reasoning hints from a plan without invoking models or subagents.

itemId.description: Optional stable plan item or project item id to select.

tools.title: Get Plan Execution Hints

outputSchema.title: Repo Test Architect Plan Execution Hints

tools.name: explain_target
tools.description: Explain the evidence, risk, testability, and recommendation for one target in an existing audit/v1 artifact. Use this after audit_repo or audit_projects when one target needs detail beyond the audit summary. Returns target-explanation/v1 without rescanning the repository, executing tests, or writing files.

audit.description: The audit/v1 object returned by audit_repo or contained in projectAudits.audits[].audit; pass the artifact itself, not a file path.

targetId.description: Exact stable id from an audit target in untestedCandidates, coveredButRisky, recommended, or skipped.

tools.title: Explain Audit Target

tools.name: rank_test_candidates
tools.description: Rank testable audit targets by risk reduction and maintenance cost.
tools.title: Rank Test Candidates

tools.name: analyze_test_placement
tools.description: Derive advisory test-placement findings from an existing single-project audit/v1 artifact. Use this for one audited project; use analyze_project_test_placement for a project-audits/v1 artifact. Does not rescan the repository, execute tests, or create, move, or modify files.

audit.description: The audit/v1 object returned by audit_repo or contained in projectAudits.audits[].audit; pass the artifact itself, not a file path.

owner.description: Optional owner label for the audited project. Defaults to audit.profile.root.

tools.title: Analyze Test Placement

tools.name: generate_selected_test
tools.description: Return a structured deferred result. This tool does not generate or write test code while native generation remains disabled.

planItemId.description: Stable plan item id selected for future generation.

tools.title: Generate Selected Test (Deferred)
